entries.title: Mark 15:1
segments: And straightway in the morning the chief priests with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

entries.title: Mark 15:2
segments: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering saith unto him, Thou sayest.

entries.title: Mark 15:3
segments: And the chief priests accused him of many things.

entries.title: Mark 15:4
segments: And Pilate again asked him, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they accuse thee of.

entries.title: Mark 15:5
segments: But Jesus no more answered anything; insomuch that Pilate marvelled.

entries.title: Mark 15:6
segments: Now at the feast he used to release unto them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.

entries.title: Mark 15:7
segments: And there was one called Barabbas, [lying] bound with them that had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

entries.title: Mark 15:8
segments: And the multitude went up and began to ask him [to do] as he was wont to do unto them.

entries.title: Mark 15:9
segments: And Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

entries.title: Mark 15:10
segments: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

entries.title: Mark 15:11
segments: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

entries.title: Mark 15:12
segments: And Pilate again answered and said unto them, What then shall I do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

entries.title: Mark 15:13
segments: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

entries.title: Mark 15:14
segments: And Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him.

entries.title: Mark 15:15
segments: And Pilate, wishing to content the multitude, released unto them Barabbas, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

entries.title: Mark 15:16
segments: And the soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

entries.title: Mark 15:17
segments: And they clothe him with purple, and platting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;

entries.title: Mark 15:18
segments: and they began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

entries.title: Mark 15:19
segments: And they smote his head with a reed, and spat upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

entries.title: Mark 15:20
segments: And when they had mocked him, they took off from him the purple, and put on him his garments. And they lead him out to crucify him.

entries.title: Mark 15:21
segments: And they compel one passing by, Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go [with them], that he might bear his cross.

entries.title: Mark 15:22
segments: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

entries.title: Mark 15:23
segments: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

entries.title: Mark 15:24
segments: And they crucify him, and part his garments among them, casting lots upon them, what each should take.

entries.title: Mark 15:25
segments: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

entries.title: Mark 15:26
segments: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.title: Mark 15:27
segments: And with him they crucify two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

entries.title: Mark 15:28
segments: [And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was reckoned with transgressors.]

entries.title: Mark 15:29
segments: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ha! Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

entries.title: Mark 15:30
segments: save thyself, and come down from the cross.

entries.title: Mark 15:31
segments: In like manner also the chief priests mocking [him] among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

entries.title: Mark 15:32
segments: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reproached him.

entries.title: Mark 15:33
segments: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

entries.title: Mark 15:34
segments: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

entries.title: Mark 15:35
segments: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.

entries.title: Mark 15:36
segments: And one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to take him down.

entries.title: Mark 15:37
segments: And Jesus uttered a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

entries.title: Mark 15:38
segments: And the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom.

entries.title: Mark 15:39
segments: And when the centurion, who stood by over against him, saw that he so gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

entries.title: Mark 15:40
segments: And there were also women beholding from afar: among whom [were] both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

entries.title: Mark 15:41
segments: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him; and many other women that came up with him unto Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 15:42
segments: And when even was now come, because it was the Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

entries.title: Mark 15:43
segments: there came Joseph of Arimathaea, a councillor of honorable estate, who also himself was looking for the kingdom of God; and he boldly went in unto Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:44
segments: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

entries.title: Mark 15:45
segments: And when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to Joseph.

entries.title: Mark 15:46
segments: And he bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

entries.title: Mark 15:47
segments: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the [mother] of Joses beheld where he was laid.
